objective: Attract prospective students using employer and career-opportunity messages.
businessContext: The FTC alleged that advertisements created false impressions of relationships and job opportunities with major employers.
strategy: Use recognizable employers as proof of career relevance.
outcomes: The settlement included $50 million in cash and cancellation of $141 million in student debt.
whatFailed: Borrowed institutional credibility was not supported by the represented relationships.
transferConditions: Use when education or employment marketing invokes partners, placements or future outcomes.
nonTransferConditions: Do not generalize settlement values beyond this case.
